LESSON: CLEANING WASTE DISPOSAL FACILITIES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTICES
Topic 3.1: Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities, part of HYGIENE PRACTICES in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How does cleaning waste disposal facilities promote hygiene?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving: Reflection skills as learners assess their success in cleaning of waste disposal facilities.

Values:
Responsibility: Taking safety precautions as learners clean waste disposal facilities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental awareness as learners clean waste disposal facilities to promote hygiene in their living places.

Link to other learning areas:

Learners relate cleaning of waste disposal facilities to aspects of good health learnt in Integrated Science
